name: Tesseract Pose
description: Convert a Rhino Plane or COMPAS Frame in explicit user units to an exact native Tesseract Pose in metres.

inputParameters.name: frame
inputParameters.description: Rhino Plane or COMPAS Frame relative to the working frame selected downstream by Tesseract Motion Program.

inputParameters.name: metres_per_user_unit
inputParameters.description: Required explicit scale: one coordinate unit multiplied by this value equals metres. Use 0.001 for millimetres.

inputParameters.name: working_frame
inputParameters.description: Exact Tesseract working-frame link identity. Unconnected defaults to base_link.

outputParameters.name: pose
outputParameters.description: Exact native Pose subclass with translation in metres and retained working-frame identity.
